**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear, concise description of what the problem is, e.g. "It's hard to

**Describe alternatives you've considered**

**Which part of the system would this touch?**

- [ ] `src/graphEngine.js` (sensing/simulation/decision/gate/explain logic)

- [ ] `public/` (control-tower dashboard UI)
- [ ] CI / repo tooling
- [ ] Other (please describe)

**Additional context**
Add any other context, mockups, or examples here.
